name: Anantapar
description: Anantapar was a planet located in the Anantapar system in the Yarith sector, which was located in grid square K-18 of the Standard Galactic Grid and in the Greater Javin region of the Outer Rim Territories. It was situated along the Corellian Trade Spine super-hyperroute.
